project.title: Genome projects for evolutional studies of the family Acetobacteraceae
project.description: We are pursuing a research project to comprehend the evolutional status of the family Acetobacteraceae based on genome analyses. First 18 bacterial genomes were projected to read the genome DNA sequences. We will provide data of more bacterial genome and moreover transcriptome by mRNA sequencing.
